##


How to Make a Dandy’s World OC for Halloween: Bring Your Own Toon to Life


#


Halloween is the season for spooky original characters, and a fan-made Toon is one of the most fun ways to celebrate it. Picture your own OC, maybe a flickering candle, a sleepy bat or a grinning jack-o’-lantern, stepping into a Toon world built just for it: a haunted town you design, with its own stat card, personality and Twisted side. The four steps below take your Toon from a sketch to a playable character in Redbean, and they work for any Dandy’s World OC, in October or any other month.


*Dandy’s World Halloween Toons recreated as pixel characters by Redbean users (cre: rickwig, marinaamoroso_22wb, daddipoppins_ey5v)*


####


Step 1: Plan your Toon’s stat card


Every Dandy’s World OC maker starts with these:


- **Name and object:** what your Toon is made of, like a candle, a bat or a jack-o’-lantern
- **Type:** healer, extractor, support, or a mix such as healer-extractor
- **Ichor price:** how rare your Toon would be in Dandy’s shop
- **Twisted form:** how your Toon changes
- **Canon friends:** who your Toon teams up with, from your favorite Toons to other fan OCs


####


Step 2: Create a playable Toon in Redbean


Upload an image or sketch of your Toon, and Redbean turns it into a playable pixel Toon that walks around your town, has memory and emotions, interacts with its surroundings. You can also tweak its look with a short description or try another sketch.


####


Step 3: Turn the stat card into a persona


Your Toons don’t just exist. Use the stat card to define your Toon’s personality, lore and speaking style, then set its connections to other characters, from friends to rivals. A shy candle Toon who idolizes Gourdy will talk very differently from a bold pumpkin rival.


####


Step 4: Build your Halloween town and roleplay a scene


Restyle your town **in any theme** with a few words such as “haunted candy factory at night.” Then expand the map and **build a whole world** : connect places and add new areas like a dark forest for your Toons to explore. Finish by adding your own eerie music to set the Halloween atmosphere.


Invite a few friends into your Toon world, such as your own recreations of favorite Toons or a Twisted rival, and write a spooky scene. Talk to your Toon one-on-one, or create your own Dandy’s World AU with OCs from other fandoms or universes, such as[Forsaken OCs](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/forsaken-oc-maker) or[Genshin Impact characters](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/genshin-impact-character-maker) .

##


**Things You Need To Know About Dandy’s World Characters**


#


Dandy’s World characters list includes around 40[playable Toons](https://dandys-world-robloxhorror.fandom.com/wiki/Toons) , split by rarity, cost and stats, and new players start with one of two free Toons, Boxten or Poppy. Fans often build a “Toonsona,” an original Toon that fits the game’s retro style, using Main Characters like Astro or Vee as the blueprint. Every Toon has a matching Twisted form that hunts players on the floors below the factory, which is why a Twisted design is part of most Dandy’s World OC ideas.


*in Dandy’s World, each Toon feels like a genuine character with its own unique stats, perks, and visual charm*

**What’s the difference between a Toon and its Twisted form?**


#


A Toon is the friendly, playable version of a character; its Twisted form is the monstrous form that hunts Toons through the factory floors. Every character has both, and the game rotates a different one onto the Twisted Board each day. Some fans use Twisted forms as inspiration for a darker Dandy’s World AU redesign of their own OCs.
